title: '1 wild cards (Street)' plural and rank naming in English reward strings
repro: ?scene=home&tab=battle&lang=en&fresh=1&debug=1&notitle=1, scroll the battle tab to 'Today's treats'.
evidence: m_en1.png left panel / en_home_2.png: '1 wild cards (Street)'; the same rank is 'Alley Boss' elsewhere ('24 cards · 1 Alley Boss guaranteed', shop chest cards).
suggestion: Pluralise by {n} and use the same rank name everywhere (Street vs Alley Boss).

title: GDD still states summon cost 12 + 4n and awaken cost 3 purr; the game uses 12 + 6n and 12
repro: Open any run: summon costs are 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48 (observed), awaken button says '골골 12 필요' and the sheet says '골골 10/12'. The GDD and its core-loop line say 12+4n and purr 3. 명세_전투규칙.md already has the correct 12 + 6n and 12.
evidence: balance.ts SUMMON_STEP = 6, AWAKEN_COST = 12; d2_sel_king.png (awaken needs 12); tutorial run fish log 100 -> 88 -> 70 -> 48 -> 18.
suggestion: Update GDD sections 3.2, 3.3 and section 9 purr remarks to the spec numbers.

title: English copy errors: "Missions is now unlocked!" and "1 wild cards (Street)"
where: Unlock toast (HomeScene.announceUnlocks -> meta.toast.unlock with meta.feature.*) and Today's treats card (describeBundle wild-card text)
repro: ?scene=home&fresh=1&lang=en, await __dbg.meta.finishRuns(1); dismiss popups, start a chapter run, lose it (__dbg.battle.lose()), press Home on the result: the toast reads "Missions is now unlocked!". For the treat text: await __dbg.meta.finishRuns(3); __dbg.meta.advance({hours:30}); scroll the battle tab to y 1700.
evidence: af_e_home_after.png (toast "Missions is now unlocked!" covering the gold amount) and aa_b_scroll_1700.png (treat slot "1 wild cards (Street)").
suggestion: Use a verb that works for plural feature names ("Unlocked: Missions") and pluralise the wild-card string by count ("1 wild card").
